message: The other day, we had a little kitchen mishap while I was making dinner. I was chopping veggies and lost track of time—thankfully, the smoke alarm did its job and went off before things got too smoky. I jumped into our family group chat, and we all started sharing our smoke alarm stories, plus tips on what to do when that alarm starts beeping. It was a lighthearted reminder that having a plan is just as important as having working smoke alarms. Do you have a family escape plan, or do you just wing it like we do?
